data.narrative:
DefSecIntel is a Series A-stage company in the Defense & Security sector. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 4 same-sector, same-stage private companies—Stark Defence, Castelion, Singularity, and NODA AI—with valuations ranging from $125M to $4.0B. This universe reflects the wide dispersion typical of early-stage defense tech, where capital intensity and go-to-market timing create substantial variance in valuations.

The peer-median method is the primary applicable triangulation approach given available data. The median valuation across the 4-company cohort is $700M, with a range spanning $125M at the low end (NODA AI) and $4.0B at the high end (Stark Defence). This method yields a point estimate of $700M. The analysis supports a valuation range of $595M to $805M, centered on the peer median. The wide dispersion within the comparables—a 32x spread between minimum and maximum—underscores material uncertainty around where DefSecIntel sits relative to these peers. Key drivers of valuation positioning within this range will include revenue traction, customer diversification, technical differentiation, and capital efficiency relative to the sample companies.
